title: Johann Sebastian Bach, Yo-Yo Ma - Cello Suite No.1 in G major (1)

lines.l: Yo-Yo Ma performing the Prelude from Bach's Cello Suite,
number one at 114 in your Hall of Fame.
And at 170, we were spending a bit of time with Ennio Morricone
with the main theme from Cinema Paradiso,
And now to the man with more entries than anyone else in your chart, Mozart.
He wrote this next piece back in 1787.
Originally, it was called Serenade No. 13 for strings.
that's before it took on another name
after Mozart scribbled it on a manuscript
